title: card.motion.mode Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response from configuring accelerometer motion monitoring parameters. The response reflects the Notecard's current accelerometer configuration.

start.description: `true` if the Notecard accelerometer is enabled and motion tracking is active.

stop.description: `true` if the Notecard accelerometer is disabled and motion tracking is stopped.

seconds.description: The period (in seconds) of each bucket of movements being accumulated when `minutes` is used with `card.motion`.

motion.description: The motion threshold (number of motion events in a single bucket) above which the Notecard state is considered `moving` and below which the state is considered `stopped`.

samples.title: Motion Tracking Enabled Response
samples.description: Response showing motion tracking is enabled with the active bucket period.

samples.title: Motion Tracking Stopped Response
samples.description: Response showing motion tracking has been disabled.
